label: fixed-teacher-constitution-contrast
note: Two batches of the same twelve development prompts under agency/care C0, using the fixed 27B teacher and exact OCT constitution_system wrapper. Each batch starts with seed 81001. This tests constitution-conditioned target differences, not training effects or held-out performance. The 2048-token output cap reduces censoring; actual training generation uses 1536. Selected after the edit-only screens and before the training outcome. Previous 9B behavioral probes used a different system wrapper and seed, so this is not a clean causal comparison between model sizes.
